mode.title: Mode
mode.description: rates = one row per benchmark per day with volume and percentiles. spreads = one row per day with every benchmark side by side and SOFR against the target range. operations = repo and reverse repo results.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How far back to pull rates, counting from today. Rates publish on business days only.

startDate.title: Start date (optional)
startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides days back for a fixed window, including years of history.

rateTypes.title: Rate types (optional)
rateTypes.description: Rates mode. SOFR, SOFRAI (the averages and index), BGCR, TGCR, EFFR, OBFR. Empty returns all six.

operationType.title: Operation type
operationType.description: Operations mode. Repo adds cash to the market, reverse repo drains it.

operationCount.title: How many operations
operationCount.description: Operations mode. How many of the most recent operations to return. Each can produce a row per collateral type.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
